name: Nogueira de Ramuín (Spain)
description: Vertically divided green and blue by a narrow white pale, the green charged with a yellow knife-grinder's wheel with an umbrella and the blue with nine yellow bells charged with red crosses.
history: Municipal flag of Nogueira de Ramuín; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: narrow white pale between the green and the blue
knife-grinder's wheel with an umbrella on the green and nine bells on the blue
